# Sources: practitioners, round 2 (2026-10-30)

"Full" means the page or email itself was read; "summary" means only a search summary or a secondary write-up;
"paywalled" means only the free intro was visible. Vendor means the publisher sells what it measures or teaches.

## Newsletters received by email (read 2026-10-30)

Vendor and practitioner newsletters (Pierre Herubel, Gojiberry, HeyReach, Formula Agents, MimikFlow, Sendpilot,
Scalezia, Greg Philippe, Lasse and Harald), read 2026-10-30; claims from them are graded Vendor claim or Practice
in `evidence.md`.


Searched with no result in these newsletters: Josh Braun, 30MPC, Lavender, Jason Bay, Becc Holland, Will Allred,
Justin Michael, Florin Tatulea, lemlist, Waalaxy.
